item.title: Sony Rolls Out New Official PS5 Update After Major Hack
item.description: The digital arms race between Sony and PlayStation hackers continues. Shortly after the PlayStation 5 homebrew community found a way to jailbreak the console's latest firmware , Sony released a new PS5 update that will likely reset this progress.

item.title: Where to find a lieutenant tower in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Once you know where to look, lieutenant towers in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode are easy to find, but when you're tasked with locating and climbing one as part of your initial tasks? That's where you may need a little help, because DMZ introduces a lot of new features never seen before in a Call of Duty game.

item.title: Disney Officially Announces Glee Reboot Is Happening
item.description: Somehow, Glee has returned. After Ryan Murphy spent most of the press circuit for his recent FX series The Shards talking about how he wanted to reboot his iconic musical comedy-drama series, it has become a reality. On Wednesday, Disney and Hulu announced that the Glee reboot is officially happening, reviving the fan-favorite TV franchise after more than a decade.

item.title: The Entire Internet Is Officially In Crisis Mode Today
item.description: Don't be surprised if your favorite website is completely down on Wednesday. A massive security risk has just been discovered, and it impacts nearly every popular website on the internet. That includes websites like Wikipedia, Slack, Spotify, and even Pornhub just to name a few. WordPress at large is at risk, and that platform is estimated to power nearly a fourth of the internet .

item.title: How to find a dynamic op phone in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode has dynamic op phones scattered around the map, which let you begin a dynamic operation even when you're in free roam mode. Collecting one of them is required to complete the DMZ order "Payment Due," which is in the second stage of the "Human Intel" chapter, but completing this requires you to know what to look for in order to find a dynamic op phone.

item.title: Xbox's Official Shakeup Continues Through 2027 with New Rounds of Layoffs
item.description: The massive layoffs at Xbox Game Studios are far from over. Under new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, the company has already cut 1,868 jobs since announcing in July that it would be reducing its headcount by 3,200 over the next year. Sharma is currently planning three additional rounds of layoffs for October, November, and January, according to a new report. Fortune noted that Xbox's layoffs have hit company veterans particularly hard, a move that is likely to erode institutional knowledge.

item.title: Crimson Desert DLC Officially Confirms Huge New Features List
item.description: After Pearl Abyss announced a brief delay at the end of September for Crimson Desert 's upcoming DLC, Charting the Unknown is now just over one week from being released. While the developer has been steadily updating and streamlining the overwhelmingly large RPG since its release back in March, the game's first DLC marks an even more massive overhaul that brings much-needed fixes as well as more systems than most players will know what to do with. We had a general idea of what would be included in Charting the Unknown, but now Pearl Abyss has released a comprehensive feature list, and it is more ambitious than we could have expected.

item.title: Pokémon Is Officially Planning a Big Retail Expansion in 2029
item.description: For most Pokémon fans around the world, the best way to get Pokémon merchandise is online. The Pokémon Center online store has fun goodies like a Halloween collection and a line of merch made in collaboration with the European Space Agency . Pokémon fans in Japan have plenty of physical retail stores to shop at, and permanent physical Pokémon Centers also operate in Singapore and Taiwan, with one in Thailand set to open by the end of the year.

item.title: Stranger Than Heaven May Have Forgotten One Thing That Made Yakuza Great
item.description: I’m from the Bay Area, so I was especially excited to experience RGG’s riff on old-timey San Francisco in the prologue. Turns out, it’s not an explorable area, and the buildings and narrow alleyways had more of a generic East Coast feeling to me. Given how vividly this studio has captured real-world neighborhoods like Waikiki, Kabukicho, and Dotonbori in previous games, I was hoping for more, especially given the time period. (There was an extremely elaborate World’s Fair in San Francisco in 1915!) There’s certainly a lot of fog and it looks miserably cold at night, so at least that part is accurate.
